title: Program Launch System
description: A four-image reference-dependent campaign that locks one fitness-program launch language across coach-led hero, plan, and conversion surfaces.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the coach authority, transformation-oriented palette, and sign-up-ready layout. Images 02-04 depend on that anchor while extending the same system to promise, weekly-plan, and mobile-conversion use cases.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-transformation-promise-board, 03-weekly-plan-poster, 04-mobile-signup-variant. Queue may run 02-transformation-promise-board, 03-weekly-plan-poster, 04-mobile-signup-variant concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
